description: A handful of figures with their labels; by default the first leads (its own role, the first accent that reads on the ground) and the rest read as its comparison, or co-equal with lead null; side by side when the box is wide enough, else label-left, figure-right lines; tiles only when the data asks for the panel variant.

metrics.label: string
metrics.value: string, the figure as written (the data's own precision)

data_schema.variant: horizontal | stacked | panel (optional; panel only when asked for)
data_schema._id: instance id prefix, set by the slide

roles.label: type.caption
roles.lead_ink: computed when left out (see the report)
roles.panel_fill: required for variant panel: a tile's fill has no neutral value

data_schema.lead: metric index that leads (default 0), or null for co-equal figures

size_domain_emu.source: the size domain of the seed this component was made from

variants.horizontal: flex row of one column per metric: figure over its label
variants.stacked: flex column of rows: label (takes the rest) beside its figure (as wide as the widest figure measures)
variants.panel: flex row of filled tiles, one per metric: figure over its label inside roles.panel_fill (only through data['variant'])

variant_rule: data['variant'] when given; otherwise the seed's rule: parts >= 2 and width // parts >= height, with parts = the metric count; plus every figure must measure onto one line in its horizontal column, else stacked. Never panel unless asked.

tests.held_out_box_note: the seed's held-out strip is 9,144,000 wide, the whole 4:3 keybank slide; with the harness margins it ran past the slide (validation: shape extends past the slide), so the held-out box is keybank's content width, 9,144,000 - 2 x space.margin 381,000

single_line_rule: a figure never wraps: '$1' over '4' is a misread number
